name: iea-wind-data-catalogue-site
description: Astro renderer for the IEA Wind Data Catalogue. Records stay canonical CKAN JSON in ../records; this package never writes to them (ADR-0032).

scripts.build: npm run tokens && astro build && pagefind --site dist && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-ckan-gate.mjs && node scripts/check-urls.mjs
scripts.gates: node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-ckan-gate.mjs && node scripts/check-urls.mjs && node scripts/a11y.mjs
